# How a rule is kept from acting on an opinion by a detour

That a classifier gave an opinion, or that a precaution acted, is recorded as a fact. A rule
triggered by such a fact would let an opinion do what only a fact may.

## The sentence put forward

"No rule is ever triggered by a fact that says a classifier gave an opinion or a precaution
acted."

## Its flaw

It does not cover a rule that counts facts. "Five denied connections in a minute: stop the
computer" would count denials that a precaution made, so an opinion could stop a computer.

## To do before an answer

Read how the record keeps the facts a precaution writes, then put forward an answer.
